description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate any land by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
